title: Riso Lane SYS — Go and Rust template tracks

questions.prompt: How deep should this SYS pass go inside go/ and rust/?
questions.description: SYS can only edit template/files/go/** and template/files/rust/**. Contract/sample work is handoff-only. Choose the ambition level for this goal.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Coherence pass: fix broken/inconsistent scaffolds, align Jinja with existing answer keys (go_framework, go_version, language multiselects), keep docs/task runners working. No greenfield redesign of stacks.

options.label: Coherence pass (recommended)
options.description: Fix correctness/consistency for existing Go/Rust API·CLI·MCP trees; document COORD gaps; no stack redesign.

options.label: Coherence + light modernization
options.description: Same as coherence, plus sensible dep/docs polish already modeled (e.g. framework branches, README accuracy) without new answer keys.

options.label: Minimal smoke only
options.description: Only fix issues that break riso validate / Jinja / existing go unit tests; leave polish for later.

questions.prompt: Relative priority of Go vs Rust in this goal?
questions.description: Repo state: Go has samples (go-api/cli/mcp), unit tests (tests/unit/test_go_templates.py), and multi-framework API branches. Rust trees exist (Actix/Clap/Tokio) but no samples/rust-* and no dedicated unit tests.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Go first for verification against real samples; still bring Rust to independent coherence in the same goal (not deferred forever).

options.label: Go first, both in scope (recommended)
options.description: Verify Go against go-* samples; harden Rust scaffolds without requiring PLATFORM samples first.

options.label: Equal effort Go + Rust
options.description: Split work evenly even if Rust lacks samples (use synthetic answers / structure tests).

options.label: Go only this pass
options.description: Rust limited to inventory + COORD/PLATFORM handoffs; no deep Rust edits.

questions.prompt: What is the quality bar for Go HTTP frameworks (gin/fiber/echo/chi)?
questions.description: copier.yml already models all four when api_module + go in api_languages. Templates branch on go_framework in api handlers/server/go.mod. SYS must not invent keys.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All four frameworks must render coherent API scaffolds; Gin remains the sample golden path (samples/go-api).

options.label: All four coherent (recommended)
options.description: Gin golden path + fiber/echo/chi branches render and stay consistent.

options.label: Gin primary only
options.description: Guarantee Gin; other frameworks best-effort without blocking done.

options.label: Gin only + COORD handoff
options.description: Focus Gin; hand off shrinking choices or validation to COORD if others are broken.

questions.prompt: Should SYS request PLATFORM/COORD handoffs for missing Rust samples and contract gaps?
questions.description: SYS cannot write samples/*/copier-answers.yml or copier.yml. Known discoverable gaps: go_version when omits go-only MCP; no rust_* version/framework keys; no samples/rust-*.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes: PLATFORM for optional rust-api/cli/mcp answer files; COORD for go_version when-clause to include mcp_languages, and any missing validation. Do not invent keys in SYS.

options.label: PLATFORM: rust-* sample answers (optional)
options.description: Handoff to add samples/rust-api|cli|mcp copier-answers for matrix/validate parity.

options.label: COORD: go_version when includes mcp
options.description: go_version currently when cli/api only; go-mcp sample still sets go_version manually.

options.label: COORD: other contract gaps as found
options.description: Document hook/catalog/validation gaps without editing those files.

options.label: No sample/contract handoffs
options.description: Stay inside go/rust trees only; skip external handoffs.

questions.prompt: Rust stack stance for this goal?
questions.description: Templates already fix Rust API to Actix-web + CLI Clap + Tokio. There is no rust_framework answer key. Changing to Axum would be a product decision (COORD) or a silent template break.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep Actix/Clap/Tokio as the fixed Rust stack; improve correctness and docs inside that model. Framework swap only via COORD handoff if desired later.

options.label: Keep Actix/Clap/Tokio (recommended)
options.description: No framework migration; harden current stack.

options.label: Handoff Axum migration proposal only
options.description: Do not migrate in SYS; write COORD proposal for rust_framework or fixed Axum switch.

options.label: Migrate templates to Axum in SYS
options.description: Rewrite rust/api to Axum without new answer keys (riskier, still no sample matrix).

questions.prompt: What is good enough to call this goal done?
questions.description: Verification already proposed: riso validate on go-api/cli/mcp; Jinja validate; narrow tests. Confirm acceptance bar.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Go samples validate; go unit tests pass; Jinja templates for go/rust parse; no writes outside go/rust; COORD/PLATFORM handoffs written for known gaps; Rust structure coherent without requiring new samples.

options.label: riso validate go-api/cli/mcp
options.description: uv run riso validate --answers-file samples/go-*/copier-answers.yml --json

options.label: tests/unit/test_go_templates.py
options.description: Narrow maintainer pytest for Go tree

options.label: validate_jinja_templates.py
options.description: When available for go/rust paths

options.label: No writes outside go/ and rust/
options.description: Hard success condition for the lane

options.label: COORD/PLATFORM handoffs filed
options.description: Documented contract/sample gaps

options.label: Block done until rust samples exist
options.description: Would require PLATFORM work; not SYS-writable
